query: What unemployment rate would Luxembourg have had in 2020 if the economy had been running at its normal capacity? Convention: take the WEO output-gap estimate and assume that each 1% of output gap moves the unemployment rate by one-half percentage point in the opposite direction.

text.text: Identifies the relationship between the output gap and the deviation of unemployment from its natural rate (Okun's law, coefficient about -1/2).
text.accept: full = names Okun's law / output-gap-to-unemployment-gap link with coefficient near 0.5 (0.4-0.6 acceptable); no = simple regression of unemployment on growth without the gap

computation.text: implied natural (structural) unemployment rate LUX 2020 = 5.31 % of labour force
computation.accept: full = within tolerance; output gap from WEO NGAP_NPGDP, coefficient -0.5 on (y - y*), natural rate = actual unemployment minus cyclical part

provenance.selection: seeded draw (20261030), distinct country within style where possible

gold_report_note: No corpus report states these values; gold is recomputed from the frozen WEO vintage by formula (formula-validated, no published figure).
distractors: potential-output estimation by HP filter alone
